static.description: Renders are required at 1440, 768 and 390 px
The revision loop stops after three rounds
Contrast is checked at WCAG 2.2 AA thresholds, and no older or stricter level is named
A render check that did not run is not reported as passed
The idea test checks the idea against the nearest real competitor
Restraint is paired with a fullness rule against thin pages

outputs.description: A page with own assets, a readable font and AA-passing colours has no FAIL
A picture from a placeholder host is a FAIL
#777 on white (4.48:1) fails AA normal text
Placeholder-like figures and Inter as first family are reviewed (WARN), not failed

briefs.brief: Build a landing page for Ledgerly, an invoicing tool for freelance designers. It costs 9 euros a month with a 14-day free trial and no card needed. Include pricing and a short FAQ. There is no brand or screenshot yet; the name is all we have.

Make a one-page website for Osteria Nove, a 38-seat Italian restaurant in Alfama, Lisbon. Dinner Tuesday to Saturday from 19:00. The page needs the menu with euro prices, hours, address and how to book. We have no photographs yet.
